subject: bia
title: BIA.------AFI.DY.
description: Diagram in WAM-24, the page where Braxton argues that 'the establishment of western art music as a composer's medium has given us the possibility to experience another viewpoint' — i.e., that the western alignment, despite its separations, produces a bi-aitional asset. (C)BIA (the *concept* of bi-aitional, Braxton's term for the dual-principle structure of western culture, masculine/feminine, intellect/spirit) is crossed with AFI (affinity insight, here read in its dynamics aspect — see also AFI-DY in title). The diagram routes BIA through TH-CONT-DY (thrust continuance dynamics) into AFI on one arm and SOC-RT (social reality) → VT-AF-ATT (vibrational affinity/attitude) on another; PHY-U-C (physical universe context) → PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) feeds AFI from a separate angle, and AFI then solid-links to VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). The structural claim: bi-aitionalism, when crossed with affinity-insight dynamics, organizes western culture's thrust-continuance into two parallel routes — one running through projectional dynamics into vibrational dynamics (the intellectual-vibrational arm), one through social reality into vibrational affinity/attitude (the social-affective arm) — and the diagram makes visible why these arms appear as separate viewpoints rather than as a unified center.
